items.q: He played everything except for me and Buzzy Feiten played guitar

ctx.x: So and that was like a year and a half or so it went on. We went to South America and Europe, and it was so great. Talk about interviews, we had this one interview about Stevie. Stevie was just coming out of — actually I’ll just skip to this first — Stevie was just coming out of the “Fingertips,” “My Cherie Amour,” and into the new stuff, I’m on the album called “Music of My Mind” have you ever heard of that? And that was the first time he produced the whole album. He played everything except for me and Buzzy…
